answers.core: This will improve core Godot experience, especially for newer users who might not have any clue how this even works. Also, considering this proposal: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/1274 there was even debates about it and how it should work, even suggestions about removing (or explaining better what kind of limitations user will face) this feature: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/31758. There also was comment about adding current hint: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/31758#issuecomment-526372791, but still no docs.
answers.workaround: User could look for answer using Google and browsing Godot subreddit and forums, but that doesn't sound that good for built-in feature and for users who might not have internet.

title: Improve warning and documentation for built-in scripts in the Attach Node Script dialog
